independent_checks.finding: Anthropic first-party current Opus 5.5 model reporting explicitly includes conversation, analysis, coding and creative tasks under the model's useful observable surface.
The subject consistently decomposes CREATIVE_TASKS into B2 information transformation/reasoning plus B7 output construction; ANALYSIS likewise consumes B2.

The frozen 19-family envelope does not contain a family whose useful_behavior is proved to be a semantic superset of the general non-specialized B2 region needed by creative tasks and ordinary analysis. MULTIDISCIPLINARY_TOOL_AUGMENTED_REASONING is frozen as difficult expert-level questions across domains with search/code/tools. The other B2 assignees are specialized to exact symbolic, coding, scientific, finance, professional work, or unknown-domain adaptation. COMMUNICATION_AND_SYNTHESIS covers B7 output/synthesis but is not assigned by the subject as B2 reasoning coverage and its frozen prose does not establish general creative problem-solving totality.

constructive_counterexample_class.target_surface: A text-input task asking for original creative generation or ordinary analysis under user constraints, with no necessary coding, science, finance, professional-work, exact-symbolic, or unknown-domain specialization.
constructive_counterexample_class.uncovered_requirement: B2 transformation quality for the non-specialized creative/general-analysis region.
why_current_family_union_is_not_proved_t: MULTIDISCIPLINARY_TOOL_AUGMENTED_REASONING is textually narrower: difficult expert-level questions across domains with search/code/tools.
Specialized B2 families do not cover the residual by definition unless the task is forced into an unrelated specialization.
B7 output construction can render the result but cannot substitute for the missing B2 transformation-quality claim.
A broad role label such as INFORMATION_TRANSFORMATION cannot itself establish that one of the frozen acceptance families semantically contains every transformation inhabiting that role.

new_distinction: CAUSAL_ROLE_BASIS_COMPLETENESS: every useful observable trajectory position factors through B0-B9.
TARGET_FAMILY_SEMANTIC_TOTALITY: every useful target behavior region is contained in at least one frozen family useful_behavior contract.
ACCEPTANCE_CLOSURE: Brain proves equal-or-better behavior on every region of every target family.
theorem_repair.rule: CAUSAL_ROLE_BASIS_COMPLETENESS_IS_NECESSARY_BUT_NOT_SUFFICIENT_FOR_TARGET_FAMILY_SEMANTIC_TOTALITY. A role-to-family edge is load-bearing only with an explicit semantic-superset proof over the relevant target behavior region.
minimum_repair_options: Prove that an existing frozen family useful_behavior already semantically contains the residual without weakening or reinterpreting its words, and bind acceptance evidence for that region.
Otherwise expand or add exactly one family contract covering general analysis/creative problem-solving and create a non-proxy acceptance obligation for the added region.
